exposure: small for gestational age (SGA, < 5th centile for gestational age)
large for gestational age (LGA, > 95th centile for gestational age)
cohort: 228,242 singleton pregnancies delivered between 1991 and 2014 at Soroka Medical Center
finding: Extreme birthweights at term are significantly associated with adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
